evidence: SkeletonTargetTable::compile allows duplicate short bone names with distinct full paths; sample_compiled_pose outputs bone.name; pose_apply.rs:36-53 calls PoseTargetBindings::resolve(root,&bone.name) for every row; pose_target_binding.rs exact_names uses or_insert(first entity).
impact_or_question: Two valid skeleton bones with the same short name resolve to one scene node, so scene pose writeback overwrites one node and leaves the other unchanged.
next_action: Carry full target paths or stable target IDs to the scene binding layer and add a duplicate-leaf writeback regression.

evidence: graph_evaluate.rs sample_compiled_graph_pose filters finite_positive_compiled_clip_weight, while sample_compiled_graph_clip_event_samples visits every compiled clip regardless of weight; state_graph_sample.rs filters graph samples but not inner graph clips.
impact_or_question: Zero-weight graph clips may publish clip events even though they make no pose contribution; expected event threshold is not documented by a graph-event test.
next_action: Define zero-weight event policy and add a blend-node zero-weight event contract before changing sampling.

evidence: DefaultAnimationManager::sample_clip_pose delegates to manager/pose.rs:20 without validating skeleton topology; ClipTrackBoneLookup::new calls skeleton_bone_path when a target path is needed, and skeleton_bone_path follows parent_index in a while loop with no visited set. A valid index cycle A->B->A never terminates.
impact_or_question: A malformed cyclic skeleton and a track with a nonmatching target path can hang the public synchronous manager sampling call.
next_action: Validate parent topology or bound the ancestor walk before path lookup; add a cyclic skeleton regression for manager sampling.
